summary: Telefonica Brasil S.A. filed a Form 6-K giving notice of an Extraordinary Shareholders Meeting scheduled for July 31, 2026. Agenda items include ratifying the appointment of PriceWaterhouseCoopers as appraiser for Fibrasil Infraestrutura e Fibra Ótica S.A., reviewing the appraisal report and merger protocol, and approving the merger of Fibrasil into Telefonica Brasil with an effective date of August 1, 2026. This is a routine corporate governance filing to effectuate a merger of a subsidiary into the parent company. No terms, premiums, or advisor recommendations are disclosed. As the filing is a standard shareholders meeting notice for an internal restructuring, it is not classified as a special situation.
